core_meaning.primary_meaning: Feryal is a Persian-origin name meaning “Splendour”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Feryal corresponds to the Persian form فريال (Persian فر (far) 'splendour' + یال (yāl) 'neck'). Its core sense is splendour of the neck, one with a beautiful neck. Feryal (also Firyal, Faryal) is a Persian feminine name, analysed as a compound of فر (far) 'splendour' and یال (yāl) 'neck' — 'she whose neck is radiant / the one with a beautiful neck'. The source labelled it 'Arabic' and glossed it 'nightingale'; both are wrong for this form. (The 'nightingale' sense belongs to a different Persian word.)

persian.name: فریال
persian.long_meaning: Feryal (فریال) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن شکوه گردن، خوش‌گردن است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: फ़रयाल

arabic.name: فريال
